description: One screen: where the game's touch-screen menus go on the top screen (port/src/onescreen.cpp draws each root group there; tools/onescreen_table.py measures the layouts of your own game and writes port/src/onescreen_table.h). The data is Heavenfall's single-screen arrangement (Heavenfall Beta by popzol and BlitzWOLF, GPL-3.0, github.com/popzol/4u-heavenfall-mod-beta, core/game/data/curated: single_screen.json and game_gui/), taken at the commit in `source`, kept in its own words and units, without its gameplay changes. top_screen: layouts the game loads on the touch screen that go to the top one. layouts: a layout scaled by factor and pushed against an edge or corner (anchor), then moved by offset (pixels right and down); push: root groups pushed alone to that edge; nudge: root groups moved alone (pixels); hide: root groups not drawn; backdrop: a root group made to cover the top screen; fixed: root groups left as they are; priority and group_priority: the draw order added to the layout's groups (higher in front). arrangement: blocks (root groups of one layout that move together, `default` their place: x, y the top-left corner of what they show, in pixels of the screen they go to, scale, screen top or bottom, priority, hidden) and screens (a rule on the groups shown, all / any / none, and the place of each block there; {} the block's default); the first screen whose rule holds is the one in force. frames: sets of root groups moved together on the top screen while a scene's rule holds (scale and at: a point x, y goes to scale x + at x, scale y + at y). help_top: where the touch menus' description panel (ui006) goes on the top screen; prompt_stay_bottom: what of the yes / no box stays on the touch screen. arrangement.hides: panes inside a root group not drawn while it is placed (Heavenfall's game_gui/fixes.json, but the two it replaces with a picture of its own). What Heavenfall changes in the layout files or the executable beyond the place of a root group (panes inside a group moved, new pictures, the pad on the keyboard and the world map, the character creation's camera) is left out.
